methodology.drawdown_time_under_water: AFML SS14.5.2 (p.201-202): 95th-percentile drawdown (R units) and 95th-percentile time-under-water (years), computed on each series' own calendar-time equity curve.
methodology.not_a_gate: This lab is diagnostic only. It does not kill, promote, or reweight edges.
methodology.returns_concentration: AFML SS14.5.1 (p.199-200): HHI on positive returns, negative returns, and monthly bet counts. 0=uniform, 1=fully concentrated.
methodology.strategy_risk: AFML Ch.15 (p.211-219): bin_hr gives the minimum precision needed to sustain a target Sharpe ratio given this edge's own payoff ratio and betting frequency; prob_strategy_failure estimates the probability true precision falls short of that bar. Target Sharpe = each target's own observed annualized Sharpe (self-consistency check).
